entities.name: WHO wastewater and environmental surveillance implementation guidance
entities.description: Pilot framework for choosing pathogen targets and integrating wastewater surveillance with other public-health surveillance. It is programme guidance, not a universal sequencing protocol.

entities.name: PHA4GE Wastewater Bioinformatics Training Course
entities.description: Training in wastewater surveillance bioinformatics, data standardisation, sharing, storage and associated protocols. Check the provider for current access to individual lessons.

entities.name: PHA4GE Infrastructure Working Group
entities.description: Community work on scalable, secure computational infrastructure for public-health genomics; a starting point for requirements, not a server specification or purchasing recommendation.

entities.name: CDC–APHL public-health laboratory competency guidelines
entities.description: Competencies at beginner through expert levels across bioinformatics, informatics, surveillance, microbiology and quality management. Published in 2015; adapt to the role and jurisdiction.

entities.name: PubMLST introduction to multilocus sequence typing
entities.description: Explains conventional MLST using sequence variants at a small number of housekeeping loci, usually seven, to assign bacterial sequence types.

entities.name: cgMLST.org core-genome typing scheme overview
entities.description: Introduces core-genome MLST as allele-based typing over a defined, species-specific set of core genes. Scheme choice and allele nomenclature matter for comparability.

entities.name: ISO 15189:2022 — medical laboratories
entities.description: Requirements for quality and competence in medical laboratories. Applicable accreditation requirements depend on jurisdiction, service and the exact tests in scope; the full ISO text is not freely available here.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 17025:2017 — testing laboratories
entities.description: Requirements for competence of testing and calibration laboratories. Whether it is the appropriate route for a pathogen-genomics service depends on the laboratory, test purpose and local accreditation body.
